identity_confirmation: User explicitly confirmed the current 8080 preview as the fixed lane-following camera. SSH inspection verified that mjpg_streamer opened the XWF by-id device at 640x480. A complete occlusion sequence was not captured; do not claim one.

other_camera.purpose: Model-based obstacle and other object recognition; must not reuse fixed-camera ground homography.

source_capture: Original JPEG snapshot from the verified XWF mjpg_streamer service, 640x480, saved without resizing, cropping, undistortion or re-encoding.
point_definition: Ground-contact corner joining the bag face toward the vehicle and the face toward the rectangle interior; not the top corner or floor reflection.
measurement_source: User explicitly updated indoor distances to near=1.20m, far=1.70m from rear axle; left/right inner corners each 0.25m from vehicle centerline.
pixel_selection_method: Manual selection from the original image, assisted by color contour coordinates. Near bags show two vertical faces; use their common ground-contact vertex, not the outer silhouette corner.
pixel_uncertainty_note: Illustrative sensitivity only, not a measured bound. Image is soft and near-right contact is close to the bottom border. Independent measured validation remains required.
intrinsics_status: Historical 2026-08-31 intrinsics retained only for loader compatibility; association with XWF not independently verified. These are not newly calibrated XWF intrinsics.
limitations: Ground plane only. Fixed camera pose, focus/lens, native resolution and crop must remain unchanged. Outside the control-point quadrilateral is extrapolation. This calibration does not prove lane detection, speed control or stopping accuracy.
